CPU denial of service from a crafted RSA key in a JWK; no forged certificate. No fixed v3 release, and step's go.step.sm/crypto still uses v3 (v4 is raised to the fixed 4.1.6 in the same image). step-ca is reached only from the internal pki network (Traefik, the bootstrap step, the renewers); the worst case is a stalled CA, visible through its health check. The weekly scan and Dependabot show when upstream moves.

LLM trial on the Spark (docs/architecture/llm-trial.md), served on the internal llm network only: no port, no way out, reached only from an admin SSH session. ffmpeg decodes audio and video for multimodal requests; the trial's model is text-only and no such request is sent. Fixed in ffmpeg 9 (one without a fix); NVIDIA's 26.10 is its latest vLLM image. The trial's Compose file goes when WP5b.1 brings the real serving.

Published 2026-11-08; Alpine ships zlib 1.4-r0, but Traefik's image (v3.7.17) is not rebuilt yet. Traefik is a Go program and does not use the system zlib. Dependabot moves the pin when a rebuilt image ships.

Published 2026-11-08; Alpine ships zlib 1.4-r0, but the Python image is not rebuilt yet. Egress tests' UDP test client only (socket, struct and sys), on throwaway CI runners and the desktop. Dependabot moves the pin when a rebuilt image ships.

Java's default trust store includes roots that signed weak eMudhra intermediates, so a Java client could be fooled when it connects out. Keycloak has no way out: only the internal networks auth-front (Traefik) and db-auth (postgres-auth), whose certificates come from AetherSpark's own CA, and its database client checks against that root only. Red Hat marks it won't fix; the Keycloak base moves only with Ostium's next notice (D-008, O-035 lists it).

Uncontrolled memory allocation when guava's compact maps are deserialized. Keycloak reads requests as JSON and forms; Java serialization happens only between cluster nodes, and AetherSpark's Keycloak runs as one node with cache=local (no cluster port). Fixed in guava 33.7.2, not yet in a Keycloak release Ostium has noticed (O-035).

The system SQLite library, used in the image only by the package manager's database (rpm never runs in the container). Keycloak is Java and never loads it; the flaw needs a crafted FTS5 table and query. No fixed package yet (O-035 lists it).

The system SQLite library, used in the image only by the package manager's database (rpm never runs in the container). Keycloak is Java and never loads it; the flaw needs a crafted database file opened with FTS5 secure-delete. No fixed package yet (O-035 lists it).

The system SQLite library, used in the image only by the package manager's database (rpm never runs in the container). Keycloak is Java and never loads it; the flaw needs a crafted changeset for SQLite's session extension. No fixed package yet (O-035 lists it).

The SQLite command line's recovery command on a crafted database; the image has no use for it, rpm never runs in the container, and Keycloak (Java) never loads the system SQLite library. No fixed package yet (O-035 lists it).
